notes.title: 【DIVINE ORDERS】Patch
notes.notes:
Thank you so much for playing DIVINE ORDERS.
I’d like to share the details of the latest patch update.

● Fixed the base lodging fee to a set value
● Removed the increased base VIT cost in earlier areas after unlocking new ones
● Fixed several issue

The base lodging fee is now fixed based on the selected difficulty level.
Only the base fee will no longer increase as days pass.

As for the removal of the increased base VIT consumption in previously cleared areas after defeating a boss—
Even though this game is meant to be an exploration-based shooter,
I realized that this system may have ended up feeling more like a penalty than a challenge.
To help make the gameplay experience more open and enjoyable,
I’ve decided to remove it.
To those of you who had already figured it out and adapted—I truly appreciate your understanding.

Bug fixes include a few minor text errors that didn’t affect gameplay, and a fix for a major issue that could cause the game to become unresponsive under certain conditions after clearing a stage.

Once again, thank you so much for playing.

notes.title: DIVINE ORDERS Release
notes.notes: DIVINE ORDERS is finally released, with the hope that everyone who picks it up will have a great time. Why not take this opportunity to experience a bullet hell shooter that’s not scary?

notes.title: DIVINE ORDERS release on May,22,2025
notes.notes:
Hello, fellow shooter fans! (Or maybe future fans of the genre?)

I’m excited to announce that DIVINE ORDERS will be officially released on Thursday. May 22, 2025!

At the same time, I want to let you know that the demo will soon become unavailable.
(It still contains some bugs, and unfortunately, save data won't carry over to the full version.)

You can also check out the brand-new release date trailer—it should be live on the store page now.
Please take a look!

notes.title: Demo　Patch
notes.notes:
Fixed several display bugs and made adjustments to certain aspects of game balance.
These changes will not have a significant impact on your playstyle.
However, if you have already played DIVINE ORDERS DEMO,
please pay special attention to the following system changes.

●The duration of Absorption will no longer decrease while performing a mining action on a vein

notes.title: Demo Patch
notes.notes:
●Improved visibility of the 【NEW】indicator when new weapons or new elements are unlocked
●Changed some enemy placement in 1-4
●Upgraded the gold gauge required for Gold Rank Up
●Corrected a typographical error in the conditions for obtaining rewards for Abyss Egg
●Added item to enable control pad cross key operation from the title key config
